<script >
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var x = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
        var confirmation = document.querySelector('.wpforms-confirmation-container-full');
        if (
            confirmation &&
            confirmation.getClientRects().length > 0 &&
            window.getComputedStyle(confirmation).visibility !== 'hidden'
        ) {
            if (x === 0) {
                gtag('event', 'website_forms', {
                    event_category: 'form',
                    event_label: window.location.pathname
                });
                x = 1;
            }
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    }, 250);

    // Track telephone link clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(function (link) {
        var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (href.toLowerCase().startsWith('tel:')) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function () {
                gtag('event', 'website_calls', {
                    event_category: 'number',
                    event_label: this.getAttribute('href')
                });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>

<!-- Max Demolition: remove the duplicated quick quote drawer.
     The drawer comes from the global header. Each imported page also carries
     its own copy, so the page ends up with two elements sharing id="qqtoggle",
     two quote forms and two side tabs. This keeps the global header's copy and
     removes the extras. Safe to leave in place once the pages are rebuilt
     without their copy: with nothing to remove it simply does nothing. -->
<script>
(function () {
  function tidy() {
    var toggles = document.querySelectorAll('[id="qqtoggle"]');
    var drawers = document.querySelectorAll('.qq');
    if (toggles.length < 2 && drawers.length < 2) return;   // nothing duplicated

    var header = document.querySelector('header');
    function keeper(list) {
      if (header) {
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          if (header.contains(list[i])) return list[i];     // prefer the header's copy
        }
      }
      return list[0];                                       // otherwise the first one
    }

    var keepToggle = keeper(toggles);
    var keepDrawer = keeper(drawers);

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(drawers, function (el) {
      if (el !== keepDrawer && !el.contains(keepToggle)) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[id="qqtoggle"]'), function (el) {
      if (el !== keepToggle) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
    });
  }

  tidy();
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', tidy);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', tidy);
})();
</script>
